title: Jesus... I Said I Forgive Him So Why Does It Still Hurt?
topic: said she forgave him but the hurt keeps returning every night

bible.text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I told him I forgave him. I meant it that day. 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But every night the memory plays again like I never said it.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Saying it once opened the door. Walking through it nightly is how the wound closes.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So was my forgiveness fake? I still get angry when I remember.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It wasn't fake. Forgiveness is a decision you keep making while the feeling catches up slowly.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: How many times do I have to forgive the same thing?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: As many times as it returns. Not because he deserves it again, but because you deserve a heart that isn't carrying him everywhere.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just want one morning where it doesn't come with me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tonight hand it to Me once more. I never tire of holding what's too heavy for you.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Healing isn't one moment. It's Me binding it tighter every night.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What are you still forgiving on repeat? 🙏
